**1. INTRODUCTION**

This report documents the results of the annual cold chain integrity and food safety management system (FSMS) audit conducted at the Port Phillip Bay Cold Storage & Logistics facility. The audit was performed by the External Auditor Group (EAG) between 17 and 19 February 2025.

The scope of the audit covered the receipt, storage, and dispatch of temperature-controlled goods, including the main cold store, freezer bays, chiller rooms, and the dispatch staging area. The audit also assessed the facility's compliance with its documented FSMS, including temperature monitoring, hygiene practices, pest control, maintenance, and staff training.

The audit was conducted against the following reference standards and documents:

- AS/NZS ISO 22000:2018 – Food safety management systems – Requirements
- Codex Alimentarius – General Principles of Food Hygiene (CXC 1-1969)
- The facility's own FSMS Manual (Revision 4.2, dated 10 October 2024)

**COLD STORAGE FACILITY AUDIT REPORT**

**Facility:** Port Phillip Bay Cold Storage & Logistics
**Site Address:** 14–22 Docklands Drive, Altona North, VIC 3025
**Audit Type:** Annual Food Safety and Cold Chain Integrity Audit
**Audit Dates:** 17–19 February 2025
**Report Issue Date:** 28 February 2025
**Audit Report Reference:** AUD-2025-004

---

**1. INTRODUCTION**

This report documents the results of the annual cold chain integrity and food safety management system (FSMS) audit conducted at the Port Phillip Bay Cold Storage & Logistics facility. The audit was performed by the External Auditor Group (EAG) between 17 and 19 February 2025.

The scope of the audit covered the receipt, storage, and dispatch of temperature-controlled goods, including the main cold store, freezer bays, chiller rooms, and the dispatch staging area. The audit also assessed the facility's compliance with its documented FSMS, including temperature monitoring, hygiene practices, pest control, maintenance, and staff training.

The audit was conducted against the following reference standards and documents:

- AS/NZS ISO 22000:2018 – Food safety management systems – Requirements
- Codex Alimentarius – General Principles of Food Hygiene (CXC 1-1969)
- The facility's own FSMS Manual (Revision 4.2, dated 10 October 2024)
- Applicable Victorian legislative requirements for food handling and storage

---

**2. AUDIT TEAM AND CREDENTIALS**

The audit team comprised the following personnel:

| Name | Role | Credentials |
|------|------|-------------|
| Dr. Elena Vasquez | Lead Auditor | Certified Lead Auditor (ISO 22000), 12 years' experience in cold chain logistics auditing; Member, Australian Institute of Food Science and Technology |
| Mr. Daniel Kim | Technical Auditor | Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical), Certified Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Technician; 8 years' experience in temperature-controlled facility operations |
| Ms. Priya Sharma | Trainee Auditor | Master of Public Health; completing Lead Auditor certification (audit conducted under supervision of Dr. Vasquez) |

The audit team was accompanied by facility representatives:

- Mr. Robert Chen – Operations Manager
- Ms. Sarah Mitchell – Quality Assurance Manager
- Mr. J. Okafor – Maintenance Supervisor

---

**3. AUDIT METHODOLOGY**

The audit was conducted using a combination of document review, site inspection, staff interviews, and observation of operational activities. The methodology is summarised below.

**3.1 Document Review**

The following documents were reviewed during the audit:

- FSMS Manual and associated procedures (including temperature monitoring, cleaning, pest control, and corrective action procedures)
- Training records for all operational staff
- Calibration records for temperature monitoring equipment
- Maintenance logs and work order history
- Temperature records (digital and paper-based) for the period 1 August 2024 to 17 February 2025
- Non-conformance and corrective action records
- Customer complaint records
- Supplier approval documentation

**3.2 Site Inspection**

A physical inspection of the facility was conducted, covering:

- Main cold store (all zones)
- Freezer bays 1 through 4
- Chiller rooms 1 and 2
- Dispatch staging area
- Goods receiving dock
- Staff amenities and change rooms
- Waste storage area

**3.3 Staff Interviews**

Interviews were conducted with the following personnel:

- Mr. Robert Chen – Operations Manager
- Ms. Sarah Mitchell – Quality Assurance Manager
- Mr. J. Okafor – Maintenance Supervisor
- Two dispatch team members (names recorded in interview notes)
- One forklift operator (name recorded in interview notes)
